title: Kissed Roasted Venezuelan Black Bean Bowl
description: A roasted Venezuelan dish featuring black beans and katsuramuki-cut vegetables, perfect for a weeknight dinner, this ovo-vegetarian-friendly meal is both healthy and delicious.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the sweet potato, red onion, and red bell pepper with olive oil, cumin, smoked paprika, and salt until they are evenly coated.
Spread the vegetables in a single layer on a baking sheet and roast for 30 minutes, or until they are tender and lightly browned.
In a large saucepan, heat the black beans over medium heat until they are warmed through.
To assemble the bowls, divide the roasted vegetables and black beans among four bowls.
Top each bowl with a sliced hard-boiled egg and a sprinkle of chopped fresh cilantro.
Let the bowls cool completely before refrigerating or freezing for later use.
Reheat the bowls in the microwave or oven until the vegetables are tender and the eggs are warmed through.
